title: Total Pixel Space
synopsis: An exploration of a digital universe said to contain every possible image — every life ever lived, and countless others that never existed — using combinatorial math to put a number on it.

audienceReactions.quote: In the Library of Babel, short story by Jorge Luis Borges, published 1941, the same point was made regarding books.
audienceReactions.author: @FedericoGiesenow

audienceReactions.quote: Mate I love this. I watched this loads of times. This is genuine art.
